entities.summary: Marianela Paco Durán is a Bolivian journalist, lawyer, and politician who served as minister of communication from 2015 to 2017. A member of the Movement for Socialism, she previously served as a plurinominal member of the Chamber of Deputies from Chuquisaca from 2010 to 2015.
